pieces.script:
HOOK
Most leaders believe AI’s main impact on software engineering is *writing* code. They are missing the critical reveal.

WHAT
Agentic AI has effectively resolved the code generation problem. This means AI can now autonomously create and refine software code, a capability confirmed in a June 7, 2026 industry briefing.

WHY IS IT IMPORTANT
The moment AI mastered coding, it didn't eliminate software problems; it exposed every other, more complex challenge. These include defining precise system requirements, designing resilient architectures, ensuring seamless integration, and validating functionality. The *real* problem was never just the code itself.

WHAT DOES THIS MEAN FOR LEADERS
If your talent strategy still prioritizes coders, then you are recruiting for yesterday's problems. Shift investment to architects, system designers, and validation experts. If your engineering pipeline focuses solely on code efficiency, then you are optimizing the wrong metric. Prioritize holistic system quality, integration, and long-term maintainability. If you haven't reviewed your ethical frameworks for AI-driven development, then you are inviting unforeseen risks as agents operate independently.
